faqs.cannotAccessPage: I can't access a page. Why?
faqs.cannotAccessPageAnswer: Access depends on your role and permissions. Owners have full access, admins have most permissions, and support members have limited access.
faqs.cannotDelete: Why can't I delete an issue?
faqs.cannotDeleteAnswer: Only users with owner role can delete issues. This restriction ensures data integrity and prevents accidental loss of important information.
faqs.whenEscalate: When should I escalate an issue?
faqs.whenEscalateAnswer: Escalate when an issue requires permissions, knowledge, or decisions beyond your role. Contact your admin or owner when you encounter limitations.
faqs.whyCategories: Why are categories and tags important?
faqs.whyCategoriesAnswer: Categories and tags help organize and find issues efficiently. They provide structure to the knowledge base and enable effective search and filtering.
faqs.whereChanges: Where can I see what changed?
faqs.whereChangesAnswer: Issue history and audit logs track all changes. Admins and owners can view these through dedicated pages in the admin panel.
faqs.whoContact: Who should I contact when something is wrong?
faqs.whoContactAnswer: Contact your immediate supervisor or escalate through the hierarchy: Support → Admin → Owner, depending on the issue severity.
